findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: wintraits_opinion · Public sink: wintraits_atributos_ganadores, wintraits_panorama_categoria, wintraits_opciones_concepto, wintraits_scan_perfil · Destructive: wintraits_scan_perfil.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: wintraits_opinion · Public sink: wintraits_atributos_ganadores, wintraits_panorama_categoria, wintraits_opciones_concepto, wintraits_scan_perfil · Destructive: wintraits_scan_perfil

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

detail: Tool "wintraits_categorias_disponibles" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
